items.title: Cysic Halts Bridge After Unauthorized Mint of 10 Million CYS
items.summary: About 2.8 million CYS remain frozen at the recipient address, while onchain records show some tokens were sold before the blacklist took effect.

items.title: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
items.summary: Cysic said the incident was limited to bridge message processing and minting and did not affect the mainnet or other operational systems.
